title: AskInput
description: The `input` of a claimed job of kind `ask` (round 6): the next answer of a conversation about one item or the library. The central service gathers the background; the runner writes the instructions (its PROMPT_VERSION goes back in the result) and gives the model no tools.

model.description: chosen in the conversation: one of the runner's llm_models for this role; absent = public: llm_ask_model or llm_public_model, private: llm_private_model

scope.description: item: citations as [12:34]; library: as [#n 12:34] or [#n]

role.description: private only for a question on an own recording's page; library questions leave own recordings out

language.description: language of the answer, e.g. hu

partial.description: true: only passages chosen for the question, not the whole transcript

speaker.description: with the user's own speaker names applied

hu.description: Hungarian translation of the line, if there is one

messages.description: the conversation so far (unanswered questions left out); the last one is the question to answer
